analysis:
Only test files were supplied; no production source is in this batch. ClusterApprovalWatchTests.swift (head 30-35, 162-304) implies three behavior changes in ClusterApprovalCheck and ClusterSetupRecord.
(1) A failing set-aside now records setAt and is re-offered on the same build after ClusterApprovalFallback.failingSeconds (one hour, head 256-275). A setAt ahead of the clock also releases it (head 273).
(2) Records without setAt are treated as past the hour. This covers older builds' records (head 199/204) and the current build's own records (head 283-299), which previously stayed aside by id (base 200). So a pair whose parts kept failing on the same build will now retry hourly.
(3) Ends whose last error is negotiationFailed (coordinator-side rejection) neither add to nor reset the quick-end count (head 211-235). Local causes still count (head 239-251).
These affect local cluster availability and retry behavior, not the coordinator↔provider trust boundary. Each Mac still rechecks the approval against its own files before saving (head 142-150, 463-467). Time-based release lets an operator force a retry, but the operator already controls local state (TB-003). No regression in A-001/A-016/A-017 is evident.
ClusterOwnerServingTests.swift (unit bdab5103bcf02b81:0) came as metadata only. From the file_changes excerpt (head 68-138), declared ClusterPublicModels are reported as "qualified for public traffic" in pipeline and tensor-parallel modes without a parity record. This is limited to the declared artifactSHA256; other artifacts and undeclared models are refused. The status line says the coordinator's parity qualification decides each placement.
Integration must verify the following in the ClusterPairServingGrants/ClusterPublicModels source:
- whether this local declaration only changes a status line, or actually grants or advertises public-serving eligibility the coordinator would honor without parity evidence (T-052/T-054/A-017);
- that the setAt hourly re-offer cannot bypass coordinator withdrawal, since only the .failing reason is time-released and withdrawn/unreachable reasons appear unchanged.
The production source for both changes was not supplied, so these conclusions remain uncertain.
